messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP template + evaluation timeline for pilot

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the throughput and token-cost breakdown were helpful. We're starting to pull together an internal plan to evaluate Redwood for a 6-week pilot focused on discharge summary generation (PHI-lite) and would appreciate a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) template to set milestones, owners and acceptance criteria.

Can you share a lightweight MAP doc and a slide skeleton we can use to brief stakeholders? Also helpful to see a proposed close timeline and typical procurement windows you’ve seen for similar healthcare customers.

To be transparent, procurement is likely to want an estimated cost band and list of technical artifacts (SOC2 reports, data residency). We’ll bring in our technical lead next.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Director, Clinical Innovation
Acme Health

Attachment: —
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP template + evaluation timeline for pilot

Hi Elena — great to connect.

Attached are two starter assets: a MAP template (Google Doc) and a 3-slide wireframe (Google Slides) you can copy and adapt. Quick summary below and suggested 6-week evaluation cadence.

- MAP template: milestone table, owner column, acceptance criteria (tech + business), risk register and escalation path. Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rwd_map_template_v1
- Slide wireframe: one-slide problem / goal, one-slide pilot scope & timeline, one-slide acceptance & asks. Link: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1slide_wireframe_v1

Suggested pilot timeline (week numbers approximate):
1) Week 0: kickoff + data access + success criteria signoff
2) Weeks 1-2: integration + small end-to-end tests (smoke + metrics collection)
3) Weeks 3-4: closed-loop eval with representative dataset + quality/regression checks
4) Week 5: performance tuning (batching/kv-cache config) + cost forecast
5) Week 6: acceptance review + procurement handoff

Typical procurement notes:
- SOC 2 and a summarized security matrix can be provided; for private deployments we support VPC options.
- Cost: a pilot can range widely; we usually provide a pilot budget estimate after we know expected tokens/day and retention needs.

I looped in Marissa (CS) to propose a slide skeleton and a short master MAP we can co-author. If you can confirm the primary technical contact and any hard procurement dates, we'll bake them into the timeline.

Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena / Daniel — copying Jonas as well for rollout ops.

I pulled the starter MAP into a co-edit GDoc and populated a first-pass timeline aligned to the procurement window you mentioned. Highlights and asks below:

- Week 0 (this week): kickoff meeting (owners: Acme: Elena / Daniel; Redwood: Jordan / Marissa) — action: finalize success criteria and data access list.
- Week 1-2: integration (owner: Daniel) — deliverable: working test endpoint + sample run results.
- Week 3-4: accuracy & safety validation (owner: Marissa) — deliverable: evaluation results and top-5 failure modes.
- Week 5: performance tuning + cost forecast (owner: Jonas) — deliverable: tuned config + estimated monthly costs.
- Week 6: acceptance review & procurement packet (owners: Elena / Jordan) — deliverable: acceptance signoff and procurement-ready summary.

Immediate asks for this week:
1) Daniel: confirm SFTP/API details and an initial sample dataset (small subset).
2) Elena: confirm procurement checkpoint date (you mentioned week of Nov 15 — confirm precise day).
3) All: any other stakeholders we should include in the MAP doc (legal, security reviewers).

I also created the slide wireframe with text stubs (see Drive link) — happy to run a 20-minute stakeholder prep call if useful.

Drive links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1rwd_map_template_v1 (co-edit), https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1slide_wireframe_v1

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP after Daniel confirms the integration details.
